subject: How to speed up plotting on top of a static image

messages.author: ea58674ea0136644
messages.subject: How to speed up plotting on top of a static image
parts:
I am using ggimage to overlay plots (neural activation) on top of a static image (a brain). The image causes the plots to take a long every time I interact with a parameter having to do with the overlays. 

Is there a way to make sure only the overlays get replotted whenever a parameter gets changed? e.g overlap two plots on the same area? Or are there alternative ways of speeding things up?

One possible complication is I am using svgPanZoom to pan/zoom with the image/overlays.

Thanks!
